resources.string:
Any_Ps3 recompiles PS3 games (PPU/SPU) into native code for your device ahead of time, caching the result per game.

Your games are NEVER copied. Any_Ps3 reads the original files in place — even after rebooting your device.

A few honest notes:
• The LLVM code-generation stage is not implemented yet. You can import, analyze and manage your library today; compilation currently runs the real analyzer and reports the rest honestly.
• Any_Ps3 contains no Sony firmware, keys or game content.
Pick the folder where compiled caches will be stored. You can also import games from it later.\n\nAny_Ps3 keeps persistent read/write access to this folder — even after a reboot.
⚠ Low free space. A compile cache needs several GiB for real games.

Android restricts direct writes to this folder on Android 11+. The cache will be stored in the app\'s own storage instead (you can grant All files access later in Settings to use this folder directly).

Any_Ps3 is an original, clean-room engineered launcher.

• It contains NO Sony firmware, decryption keys, or game content.
• It does not bypass copy protection.
• You may only import and compile games that you legally own. Dumping games you own may still be restricted in your country — know your local law.
• The project is not affiliated with Sony.

By continuing you confirm that you will only use Any_Ps3 with games you own.
I understand — only games I own
Import PS3 games you own — ISO images or folder dumps.\nNothing is copied: Any_Ps3 keeps a reference and reads the original in place.
